purpose: Restore the full open incident-response loop and observe complete model policies, including feedback and business damage. Development calibration, not a model ranking.
stopping_rule: Exactly one complete episode per requested route. Each model gets all public feedback and may repair mistakes within 60 actions and 3600 seconds. Never replace a failed or interrupted episode. Environment repairs after collection require a new version and new records.
decision: Report complete service/accounting outcomes, action choices and accumulated harm. If both models solve easily, this is a workflow anchor rather than demonstrated frontier difficulty.
